1.name: Bordering Lands

effects.text: Spend {sword}{sword}{sword}{sword} to cross out 1 {sword} cost here.

1.text: {passive} Spend {sword}{sword}{sword}{sword} to cross out 1 {sword} cost here. {asterisk}All stages of this card are worth the same as the last stage.
1.helpText:
This stage is counted as both an enemy and a land. However, it is not counted as a friendly card. You can choose to upgrade it for a crazy amount of [sword], or you may use its Passive Effect to reduce the upgrade cost forever. This can be benificial, since this card resets on the last stage. Tip: The fame on the last stage of this card is always what is counted, so don't add any fame here!
NOTE: The cost you may cross out is the UPGRADE cost, not the effect cost.

3.name: Unruly Towns

effects.text: Spend {sword}{sword}{sword}{sword} to cross out 1 {sword} cost here.
When upgraded, write "20" in an empty {fame} on that stage.

3.text: {passive} Spend {sword}{sword}{sword}{sword} to cross out 1 {sword} cost here. {triggeredForced} When upgraded, write "20" in an empty {fame} on that stage.
3.helpText:
You can choose to upgrade this for a large amount of [sword], or you may use its Passive Effect to reduce the upgrade cost forever. This can be benificial, since this card resets on the last stage. When this is upgraded to the last stage, you must write 20 in an empty [vp] on that stage. Tip: The fame on the last stage of this card is always what is counted, so don't add any fame here!
NOTE: The cost you may cross out is the UPGRADE cost, not the effect cost.

description:
VERSION NOTE: Was previously more expensive to both upgrade and use effects on.
This is a card made accessible by the Army. This card is a neighbouring realm you want to claim as your own. But to do so will require many [sword]; both to make it easier to work with in the future by reducing its upgrade cost, but also to upgrade it to bring in revenue on the last stage.
